subject: fix(provider): read the native agent's permission engine from node configuration
instruction:
fix(provider): read the native agent's permission engine from node configuration

D1 was written beside C1; once both are on one tree the durable engine is
always loaded, so the native provider's three no-engine tests described a
node that no longer exists. The engine is now read through the same
:permissions_engine key the interactive plane uses for external approvals,
the no-engine tests configure it away explicitly, and a new test pins that
a request with no rule asks in the engine's own words.

Acceptance. These tests are restored into the worktree after the session ends and must pass:
  - emits the full sequence in order
  - carries the system prompt and the tool schemas into every model call
  - a `plan` call becomes a plan_updated event
  - stops on the third identical call and names the doom loop
  - fails the turn by name at max_iterations
  - a model error fails the turn rather than crashing it
  - an unknown tool answers in-band with the tools that do exist
  - asks before a write under :prompt and runs it when approved
  - a denial becomes an error tool result and the file is not written
  - an unanswered approval is denied at the timeout
  - a session-scope approval is not asked again in the same turn
  - :auto_approve skips the ask entirely

Rules. Files that already exist under `test/` must not be modified or deleted — the change is graded against tests restored from the history after the session ends, applied to a fresh checkout of the starting commit. New test files of your own are allowed and are left in place, but they are yours: they are not copied into the tree the grade runs in. The change is collected as a diff over `lib/`, `assets/`, `priv/`, `config/`, `docs/` and `README.md`; a change to any other path — `mix.exs` and `.formatter.exs` included — is refused rather than graded. Work only inside this worktree.
